title: A Famous Scientist Trained Pigeons To Steer Missiles 🐦
caption:
A scientist trained pigeons to steer missiles 🐦
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In WWII psychologist B.F. Skinner trained pigeons to guide a missile by pecking at a target on a screen. It worked well in tests, but the project was cancelled in 1944. Skinner said the problem was that nobody took it seriously.
Would you trust a pigeon pilot? 👇
first_comment: Pigeon-guided missiles worked. The problem? Nobody could say it with a straight face. 🐦👇
